component.name: FrameWork
component.summary: A free-form canvas for structured data

description.p: FrameWork is a desktop canvas for people who reach for a spreadsheet because they want to see and touch their data directly, but who think in dataframes rather than in cell addresses.

Tables and calculation blocks sit on a movable canvas. Cells are identified by table, row, and column rather than by a global grid position, so formulas keep pointing at what you meant after a rename, a sort, or an inserted row. Calculated columns hold parsed expressions, not text, and the dependency graph is checked well enough to refuse a circular reference and to warn before a deletion breaks something downstream.

ul.li: Import from CSV, TSV, Parquet, and Excel ranges, or straight from a database connection
Categorical columns with persisted, ordered allowed values and dropdown editing
Exact left and inner joins with enforced unique lookup keys and match previews
Visible, one-cell formula overrides that never hide themselves
Charts built on a grammar of graphics, with Polars doing the aggregation
A local, structured MCP API so AI agents and scripts can drive a document

description.p: This is an early prototype. Documents are stored locally and the file format is still moving.
